text:
ashwin: Heads-up — I have a small repro for an ESM/CJS interop bug with the JS SDK when bundling for edge runtimes (Vite/webpack/rollup). Default import ends up undefined in the final edge bundle and calls fail at runtime. Repro steps below. :eyes:
maria: can you paste the minimal steps?
ashwin: yes — minimal repo: create a new project with `type: \"module\"` and install the SDK. key bits: default import usage + simple edge handler.

ashwin: package.json:
```json
{
  \"name\": \"redwood-sdk-edge-repro\",
  \"version\": \"0.0.1\",
  \"type\": \"module\",
  \"dependencies\": {
    \"@redwood/inference\": \"^2.1.0\"
  },
  \"scripts\": {
    \"build:vite\": \"vite build\",
    \"build:rollup\": \"rollup -c\",
    \"build:webpack\": \"webpack --config webpack.config.js\"
  }
}
```

ashwin: index.js (edge entry):
```js
import Redwood from '@redwood/inference'; // default import used in many examples

const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RW_API_KEY });

addEventListener('fetch', event => {
  event.respondWith(new Response('ok'));
});
```

ashwin: Build with Vite (default bundling for edge) and deploy to a local edge worker shim (miniflare/wrangler) and you get: `TypeError: Redwood is not a constructor` or later `client.createCompletion is not a function`.

ashwin: Quick logs from miniflare: 
```
ReferenceError: Cannot access 'Redwood' before initialization
  at eval (index.js:1:27)
  at file:///workspace/dist/index.js:1:27
```

dana: interesting — does switching to `import * as Redwood from '@redwood/inference'` or `import { RedwoodClient } from '@redwood/inference'` change behavior?

ashwin: yes — both work as workarounds. `import * as` pulls the namespace object so `new Redwood.default(...)` no longer happens. The problem is the way some bundlers rewrite the entry and how the SDK's package.json lacks a fully explicit exports map for both cjs and esm, so consumers get the wrong shape depending on bundler heuristics.

kevin: this sounds like we need to ship proper dual-entry exports in the SDK package.json: `main`, `module`, and an `exports` field with explicit import/require targets. Also ensure `types` and `sideEffects`.

ashwin: suggested SDK package.json fix snippet: 
```json
\"main\": \"./dist/index.cjs.js\",
\"module\": \"./dist/index.esm.js\",
\"exports\": {
  \".\": {
    \"import\": \"./dist/index.esm.js\",
    \"require\": \"./dist/index.cjs.js\"
  },
  \"./package.json\": \"./package.json\"
},
\"types\": \"./dist/index.d.ts\",
\"sideEffects\": false
```

maria: also worth checking the rollup/webpack configs: some setups bundle deps by default, some mark them external. If the SDK gets bundled into consumer code and then transpiled to CJS, default interop can be lost. Repro tip: try both `external: ['@redwood/inference']` and bundling it in to see differences.

ashwin: repro matrix I ran: Vite (esbuild) -> default import breaks unless you use named import. Rollup (plugin-node-resolve + commonjs) -> default import sometimes becomes `{ default: [Function] }` shape and code that expects a constructor fails. Webpack 5 with experiments.outputModule=true -> mixed behavior across targets.

ashwin: minimal reproduce commands I used: 
1) `npm i`
2) `npm run build:vite`
3) run via miniflare: `npx miniflare ./dist/worker.js --watch` -> request -> error shown above.

dana: thanks — can you open a tiny public repro repo? makes it easier for SDK team and for QA.

ashwin: yep pushing now: https://github.com/ashwin/repro-redwood-edge-sdk (private repro link for internal team: https://git.internal/repro/redwood/edge-sdk-esm) — includes configs for Vite/Rollup/Webpack and short README with commands.

ci-bot: Created issue RED-3456 in internal SDK tracker: 
\"edge: default import interop causes runtime errors when bundled by Vite/Rollup/Webpack\" — assigned to @dana. :white_check_mark:

kevin: long-term fix: we should publish dual outputs (CJS + ESM) and add an index that uses named exports for core types (RedwoodClient) instead of relying on default export. That will make bundlers happier and also improve typings for TS consumers.

maria: agree — docs note for now: in edge runtimes prefer named imports (`import { RedwoodClient } from '@redwood/inference'`) or `import * as Redwood` until SDK package.json is updated. Add a short blurb to the onboarding guide.

ashwin: I'll open the SDK PR with exports + add a short troubleshooting note in devex docs and link the repro. Will post PR link here when ready. :thumbsup:
